[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Just an edit for Sebastian's portrait in talkohlooeys' since I don't like that they got rid of his emo hair. Piercings too, mostly my Seb headcanons.
[img width=107]https://file.garden/ajQfMjRUtCjxULKv/Sebpat.gif[/img]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Replace the Sebastian portraits in the folder with the new ones[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This is made for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30727]1.6 unnoficial update[/url] that uses portraiture, but you should be able to use it for the non seasonal version if you delete the extra portraits and change the names[/color][/size]
